notes: ACCESS: tier (a) HTTP only, no browser needed for data extraction (Playwright/CDP used only to discover the client-side API endpoint and confirm rendered h1/tab-bar; no anti-bot wall encountered). robots.txt (fetched at sostrenegrene.com/robots.txt after a 308 redirect from www) allows User-agent:* Allow:/ and explicitly allows Googlebot; no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow present, so all tiers were permitted. www.sostrenegrene.com/ itself resolves to a country-picker page (no default locale); since country=Denmark, used the /da/ (Danish) storefront, which is the site's actual home-market locale, for the whole research pass. TREE: built the category tree from https://sostrenegrene.com/da/sitemap.xml (full urlset of category listing pages, id suffix -c-NNNN) cross-checked against the rendered top-nav and each page's own sub-category tab bar (captured via Playwright network/DOM). QTY METHOD: discovered the storefront's own client-side data source, https://sostrenegrene.com/umbraco/api/catalog/search?categoryId=<id>&page=1&pageSize=48, which returns an exact 'total' field per category and is the same endpoint the rendered page uses to paginate; categoryId was resolved per URL by intercepting this network call in a headless Playwright pass. This total field showed minor live fluctuation across repeated calls on smaller categories (e.g. Baskets returned 49 and 60 in two separate snapshots, Decorative Cushions returned 18 and 22), consistent with a live, personalization/stock-driven catalog rather than a static count; a single synchronized session (one browser/session, all category calls issued back-to-back) was used for the final qty values recorded here to minimize cross-category drift, and this is noted as evidence rather than treated as a discrepancy to resolve further. h1/canonical was confirmed to match the requested node for every recorded leaf. One candidate leaf, /da/produkter/bolig/tekstiler/sengetoj-c-8337 (would-be 'Bedding', linked from on-page marketing copy), was tested and found to silently fall back to the parent Tekstiler page (h1 rendered 'TEKSTILER', categoryId matched the parent's 13, not a distinct id) - exactly the bad-slug-serves-parent trap the brief warns about, so it was NOT recorded. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected): bolig/interior/vaser-og-potter, kunstige-blomster, lysestager, lys, lamper, rammer-og-plakater, dekoration, spejle, puslespil-og-spil (all decorative/lighting/wall-decor/games, out of scope for both categories); bolig/interior/badevaerelsestilbehor-c-8332 (52 products - a mixed bathroom-accessories bin dominated by soap dispensers, mirrors, hooks, candles, toothbrush cups; only a handful of storage/textile items are scattered inside with no distinct sub-URL to isolate them, so the whole category was excluded rather than force-classified - the towel/bathmat/washcloth items it contains are already captured under Towels and Rugs, and its few storage items have no isolable listing page); bolig/kokkenudstyr/rengoring-c-8346 (cleaning products/tools themselves, not storage); bolig/kokkenudstyr/kokkentilbehor-c-8347 (186 products - general kitchen gadgets/tools; storage-purposed items like 'Opbevaringsglas'/'Opbevaringskasse' are mixed in with no isolable sub-URL, so excluded as a mixed bin per the Kitchen & Dining boundary rule); bolig/kokkenudstyr/service, borneservice, bageartikler (tableware/baking, Kitchen & Dining, out of scope); bolig/have-c-10080 and udeliv-c-10081 (garden/outdoor living - checked, contain only plant/garden-tool/parasol items, no storage or textile products); born/bad-og-pleje-c-8400 (2 products, toothbrush and cloth, irrelevant); born/borneinterior-c-8398 (a general children's-room grouping mixing furniture, lighting, decor and a couple of baskets with no isolable storage sub-URL - excluded as a mixed bin); mobler/hylder-c-8320 (shelves) and mobler/skabe-c-10790 (cabinets/wardrobes) - both explicitly nested under the site's Mobler/Furniture top-level category with furniture-type products (wall shelves, wardrobes, bookcases, cabinets with drawers), so per the Storage-Furniture boundary rule these belong to the Furniture task, not Storage, despite the marketing copy on the Skabe page using the word 'opbevaringslosninger' (storage solutions); kontorartikler/skrivebordstilbehor-c-8389 (38 products - mostly stationery/scissors/rulers with a few desk-storage items mixed in, no isolable sub-URL, excluded as a mixed bin); kreativitet/hobbyartikler/tekstiler-c-8369 (23-ish craft/patchwork/embroidery fabric explicitly under Kreativitet>Hobbyartikler for hobby sewing projects, not home-furnishing textile - excluded per the apparel/craft-fabric boundary). INCLUDED WITH CAVEATS: bolig/kokkenudstyr/kokkentekstiler-c-8345 duplicates the name of bolig/tekstiler/kokkentekstiler-c-8340 (both 'Kitchen Textiles') but are reachable via two different nav paths with two different URLs/categoryIds (137 vs 143); their totals matched (23/23) in the final synchronized snapshot but had diverged (23/27) in an earlier check, so it is genuinely ambiguous whether these are one category double-listed or two overlapping-but-distinct catalog buckets - both are kept as separate rows per the duplicate rule's carve-out for genuinely different listing URLs, flagged accordingly. accessories/smykker/smykkeopbevaring-c-8421 (Jewellery Storage: jewellery boxes/stands/bowls) sits under the Accessories>Jewellery nav branch rather than the main Bolig/Home tree, but is explicitly named 'storage' by the site and matches storage.md #7's Jewellery Organizers inclusion, so it is included at MEDIUM confidence.
